pr_title: planner: fix index merge plan when expr cannot be pushed to tikv
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: guo-shaoge <shaoge1994@163.com>

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #30200

Problem Summary:  The original implementation of IndexMerge didn't consider situations when there are exprs which cannot be pushed to TiKV.  It will cause two problems:
1. We may get error just like #30200.
2. We have to use TableScan. But actually we can put the `Selection` above IndexMerge. The latter plan is faster in some situations.

### What is changed and how it works?
1. In `generateIndexMergeOrPaths`, we consider `allConds` in DataSource instead of only `pushedDownConds`. So we can generate IndexMerge path even exprs in filter cannot be pushed down to TiKV.
2. In `buildIndexMergeTableScan`, we check `tableFileders` in DataSource explicitly. There will be two situations:
    **2.1**: Filter can be pushed to TiKV: we put these filters in copTask's tablePlan, which will be executed by coprocessor.
    **2.2**: Filter can not be pushed to TiKV, but can be pushed to other storages: we will create a new Selection to handle these filters(_copTask.handleRootTaskConds_). No need to consider expressions that can neither be pushed down tikv nor other engines, because in logical optimization we already put these filters in Selection.(check [here](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/732b7eb128ed0f251d9ce92509a3aaad63f02a80/planner/core/rule_predicate_push_down.go#L122).

issue_context.title: Got error when substring is used in filter
comments:
There are two ways to fix this:
1. The simpler one: pushdown substring and char_length, just as #30193 did.
2. More thorough repair: fix the plan, add Selection above IndexMerge if some exprs cannot be pushdown, just as #30341 did.
